result.reasoning: This commit introduced the Biweekly library-based iCalendar export (Biweekly.write(ical).go()) across EventEmail.java, EventsExportEventsToICal.java, CalendarServlet.java, and CalendarExport.java. It replaced the previous manual VCALENDAR text output with the Biweekly writer, but never configured a default timezone on the writer/timezone info, meaning exported date/time values were not properly localized, causing the daylight-savings bug that the fix addresses by adding writer.getTimezoneInfo().setDefaultTimeZone(TimeZone.getDefault()) to each export path. The fix directly modifies the same call sites and export logic that this commit created.
